tag: Atlantic coast · Fernandina to Ocean Reef, FL
headline: Gale warning stretched to Miami – through Tuesday
dateline: Into Tue Oct 27 – early Wed Oct 28 by zone
what: NE winds 25–35 kt, gusts to 40, seas up to 15 ft. The warning now reaches Jupiter to Ocean Reef and Biscayne Bay from 8pm Sunday.
why: Every Atlantic inlet from Fernandina to the upper Keys stays dangerous for sailboats until midweek, and Biscayne Bay will be rough and gusty.
todo: No inlet runs or outside passages before Wednesday. Snug in by Sunday evening: extra lines, chafe gear.
source: National Weather Service Jacksonville, Melbourne & Miami

headline: Cross-Florida route to close Jan 4 – Apr 30
dateline: Franklin Lock Jan 4–Mar 1 · Ortona Lock Mar 1–Apr 30, 2027
what: W.P. Franklin and Ortona locks close in turn for major maintenance. While one is shut, the other passes local traffic only.
why: For about four months of snowbird season, boats can't cross between Fort Myers and Stuart.
todo: Cross before Jan 4 or plan to go around via the Keys. Franklin Lock: 863-662-9908.
source: Notice to Navigation via Lake Okeechobee News

headline: The Jimmy Buffett Race at the Rudder Club
dateline: Sat Nov 7 · Rudder Club of Jacksonville
what: A river race of about 20 nautical miles open to all boats, plus a Cheeseburger in Paradise raft-up and sandbar party north of the club dock.
why: An easy way for cruisers to join a race – no PHRF rating? The club can give you a provisional one.
todo: Register on Regatta Network. Questions: Ken Kessler, 904-917-7245.
